prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original wide scenic establishing illustration of an elven coastal city in LINDON, the ancient elven realm beside the western sea in Middle-earth, for a One Ring culture background. Match the user's approved light-ivory pencil establishing series: Rivendell, the Shire, Dale and Khazad-dum. Camera pulled far back and elevated to a high three-quarter viewpoint overlooking a graceful sheltered coastal settlement, harbor and broad sea inlet. Elven halls with long gently swept roofs, slender columns and airy arched galleries nestle among old trees on low wooded hills above the water. Stone terraces and winding garden paths descend to curved quays and quiet boat landings. A few beautifully crafted slender elven sailing ships with high curved prows and furled pale sails rest in the harbor; one small ship sails quietly farther out in the inlet. A graceful bridge spans a narrow stream entering the harbor, and a modest beacon tower stands on a distant headland. Foreground trees, a carved but restrained stone balustrade and garden steps frame the city vista; look beyond clustered halls and harbors toward layered low coastal headlands fading into the western sea. Make the geography coherent and believable: a sheltered inlet, stone piers, forested shore and expansive water, not an inland waterfall city, not a Mediterranean human port, not a huge extravagant fantasy metropolis. Architecture is timeless, understated, organic elven craftsmanship integrated with nature. No foreground people, no portraits or prominent figures; the setting and its architecture are the subject. Mood: serene, ancient, wistful and quietly luminous, a western refuge and place of departure. STYLE: delicate traditional graphite and extremely muted brown-gray pencil on very light near-white warm ivory drawing paper, subtle grain, clear expressive fine contours, restrained parallel hatching and crosshatching, airy shading and abundant clean pale paper. Selectively detail nearby buildings, foliage and ships; distant coast and sea become lighter and simpler. Water ripples and soft sky rendered with sparse fine pencil lines and untouched paper. Keep the same pale paper tone as the approved series, no orange, peach, yellow or tan wash. No colored paint, heavy black ink fills, oil brushwork, watercolor wash, photorealism, glossy digital rendering or 3D. Wide 16:9 full-bleed landscape, intended final export 2560x1440. No writing, readable runes, lettering, labels, captions, map symbols, decorative border, frame, blank bottom strip, black bars, watermark or UI.
